roadmap_stages.title: Story — play the campaign
roadmap_stages.summary: Finish all five chapters. Story trophies pop automatically and cannot be missed. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter because there is no mission replay.

roadmap_stages.title: Missable watch + early habits
roadmap_stages.summary: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, scan every new vehicle with WAiNK, study animals through binoculars, and avoid cheats and the permanent Irredeemable profile. Progress made now already counts toward 100%.

roadmap_stages.title: Collectibles + character questlines
roadmap_stages.summary: Clear card sets, WAiNK locations, meditations, vehicle discovery, and the Andy / Kenton / Billy / Randy / Tyrone / Bret questlines plus Strangers & Freaks strands.

roadmap_stages.title: Activities, robberies & minigames
roadmap_stages.summary: The 100% grind: stunts, shooting-range golds, drone races, races, gang operations, bank jobs and vaults, fencing totals, garages and Scooter Bros registrations.

roadmap_stages.title: Cleanup — 100% & platinum
roadmap_stages.summary: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits, finish 70 of 80 challenges, mop up misc trophies, then the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. All 54 other trophies are single-player and remain available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There are no online or DLC trophies and no difficulty setting, so one playthrough is enough. Budget roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Keep cheats off your trophy save, because cheats disable trophies and saving.

steps.text: Earn all 54 other base-game trophies; the platinum then unlocks automatically with no multiplayer or DLC required.
Plan for about 200 hours in one playthrough; free-roam continues after the story so cleanup can happen after the credits.
Never activate cheats on the save you use for trophies — cheats disable trophies and saving.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1 and complete the main mission Gone Fishing; the trophy unlocks automatically.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1, then start Chapter 2 with What's in the Bag?; the trophy unlocks after that first Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Nothing on the 100% checklist is permanently missable; everything remains available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: finish the in-game 100% Completion checklist, visible after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is closer to 60% true completion — most side quests and many collectibles are only partly required. The categories that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks; elsewhere you need only a share, such as 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and earlier progress already counts.

Clear Story & Tasks in full where required: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 vaults, plus fencing totals ($100k narcotics, $100k jewelry, $250k marked bills, $200k vehicles) and 100 optional tasks.
Clear Exploration & Activities: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and all 15 Bret Target Decks.
Finish Discovery: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with WAiNK and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars (no hunting required for the study count).
Start scanning vehicles and studying animals during the story to save many hours of cleanup later.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Stunts stay marked on the map and can be finished in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida, mixing the four types freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The optional challenge attached to each stunt jump is not required — performing the stunt once counts. Under-the-bridge flights in a helicopter are the fastest way to pile up numbers. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

steps.text: Pick any mix of the four stunt types (130 jumps, 202 bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps) to reach 250; repeats of the same stunt add nothing.
Track totals under Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 for the by-region view) and names under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Use a helicopter along the Balsero and Bayside canals to clear many under-the-bridge flights quickly; knife flights are all between Vice City buildings.
Ignore each jump's optional challenge — landing the stunt once is enough for the counter.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. All nine activity types remain available in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (score one basket), an arcade/video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked as blue icons when you unfog the map, so this normally pops on the way to 100% without dedicated effort.

steps.text: Do each of the nine types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, a race win, and a stunt.
Check what is missing under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; hovering an activity shows how many times you have done it.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the nearest example of any missing type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Both ranges stay open in free-roam; rented weapons are good enough for gold.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges across two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City (6 moving courses × 3 difficulties = 18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch north-east of Port Gellhorn (6 stationary score courses × 4 difficulties = 24 golds). Buy the $5 waiver pass from each clerk first, then the courses appear on the map. Finishing or quitting a course permanently raises Focus, which also helps Gunslinger.

steps.text: At each range, buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk so the six courses are marked; rent weapons for $10 if you lack the required type — rentals can reach gold.
At Griffin, play as Lucia (faster movement), keep moving and shoot targets quickly instead of chasing bullseyes; use slow-motion on the small red spinning targets in Hook/Loop.
At Rodgers Ranch, build the score multiplier with one or two body hits before the headshot and avoid missed shots, which reset the multiplier.
Track medals under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges; all 42 golds are also required for 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. All 14 locations remain available; Dalton Island needs a boat or aircraft to reach.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location has three time trials: beat the par time on the first two to unlock the third, which only needs to be finished for 100%. The trophy only needs one win per location, but the 100% checklist needs all 42 trials, so clear all three while you are at each stop. Hold the stick forward for full speed and avoid crashes.

steps.text: Find locations via Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones (blue icon within ~100 m) and win one race at each of the 14 locations.
Beat par on trials 1 and 2 to unlock trial 3; trial 3 only needs finishing for 100%, giving 28 par-beating runs of 42 total.
Work south to north (Hamlet → Millport) and use a taxi between stops; Dalton Island is boat/aircraft only.

The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins plus 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals, so this trophy pops well before 100% is done if you race as you explore.

steps.text: Win 20 distinct races; there are 40 to choose from and repeats do not count.
Find races under Map > Activities > Racing (blue icons) and track wins under Progress > Activities > Racing.
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist after the trophy pops at 20.

steps.text: Meet Cal in Chapter 1 (Feng Shui), then follow his text to the purple fishing icon and work through his fishing quests.
Catch the requested fish (an early request is a Parrotfish over 2 kg) from a boat with a fishing rod in the marked area.
Beat Cal in the final fishing challenge to unlock the trophy.

steps.text: Pick any of the four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, or Bang For Your Buck on a world cabinet.
Finish all levels of that game once; beating its internal challenges is not required.
Play the other three games too — 4 of 4 video games played is a 100% checklist line.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Andy's quests remain available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest line as Lucia. It starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls Lucia and texts her Belville address, marking the quests on the map. Play them in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. The line is Lucia-only, so switch characters if the marker does not appear.

steps.text: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's call and follow her texted Belville address to start the questline.
Complete the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain → Pay the Cellerica Fee → Peach! → Read the Label → Puff Puff Pass.
Finish Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) to unlock the trophy; the quests stay available after the story.

trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2–3 and stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. He is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams and sends you to seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, and bring it back. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. The 100% checklist needs 5 of 7 sets plus all 33 underwater discoveries, so finishing Kenton also feeds A Long Road.

steps.text: Meet Kenton (green KR icon, Key Lento) after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 and accept his shipwreck treasure jobs.
Dive at each purple chest marker and use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, then return it to Kenton; clear all 7 shipwrecks.
If Kenton vanishes after Chapter 1, keep playing — he texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3 (calling Brian as Jason can speed it up) and remains after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. Because the full qualifying list is still being confirmed, watch the trophy tracker in your trophy list after each strand. steps.text: Complete strands for confirmed strangers Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie lines.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Randy's Wish List can still be completed after the story.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List. The list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner and has you deliver the first car (Granforma Zorrusso). Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list, hunt hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and deliver to Randy's garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Undamaged cars pay more — Randy's payouts also cover the $200,000 vehicles-fenced line for 100%.

steps.text: Unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS); the Zorrusso delivery counts as the first car.
Scan high-end cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list, then drive them to the RK garage in west Vice City; track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
Deliver all 16 cars (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D plus the Zorrusso).

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two-part line as Jason. The line is Jason-only, so switch off Lucia if the markers do not show.

steps.text: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Complete Tyrone's follow-up Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only one in the game. The first meditation at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1 (morning after Down to Earth) and is gone after Chapter 1; it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy requires it, so do not skip it. There is no mission replay — keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Meditate until the counter reaches 18 across 10 spots. Eight free-roam spots count twice (once as Jason, once as Lucia, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), plus the Chapter 1 balcony session and the final Ascent session on Mount Kalaga, which only appears after all others. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18, but this trophy needs every spot — including, possibly, the missable Chapter 1 session.

steps.text: MISSABLE FIRST: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen, follow her to the balcony, focus on her and choose Accept to log meditation 1.

After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), visit the eight outdoor spots with both characters: Smooth Sand (Mariana), Swamp / Worn Stone / Red Rocks (Kelly), Water Wheel / Jutting Cliff / Waterfall (Lummox), Seaside (Leonard).
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations after each session; spots show a purple icon when you are close (Map > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida).
Finish with Ascent Mountain — the stone circle on Mount Kalaga's summit, which appears only after every other meditation is complete — for meditation 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Bret's Target Decks remain available after the story (Jason only).
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret requests. Bret Vogel texts Jason after Coffee Break (Chapter 2) — Lucia cannot receive the message — starting with Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He marks hunting spots with purple icons (Target Decks); bring the animals back as Jason. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed, but 100% needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

steps.text: As Jason after Coffee Break, follow Bret's text to Veteran Hunted in Lummox County to start his hunting line.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons, Map > Activities > Target Deck) and deliver them to Bret as Jason.
Complete all 15 Target Decks for 100%; the trophy pops along the way (exact trigger animal still unconfirmed).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missable_note: Not missable as a trophy (any 3 of 18 sets). Note: one Delights Dancers card (Vicki, Starlet Motel office) must be collected before the end of Chapter 2 or that interior closes — pick a different set if you missed it.
trophies.guide: Complete any three of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 unique cards total; sets hold 12–36 cards, and each colour version counts separately). Cards hide inside enterable buildings on surfaces and walls, and outdoors in yellow phone boxes and toolboxes; they cannot be farmed by buying items. Selling a card at a pawn shop does not remove it from your collection. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this trophy is an early milestone on that road — smallest sets (Backyard Wrestling 12, Delights Dancers 18) finish fastest.

steps.text: Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards and target the smallest sets first (Backyard Wrestling 12 cards, Delights Dancers 18).
Search enterable interiors (darker-shaded buildings on the map) on desks, boards and nightstands, and outdoors check yellow wall phone boxes and toolboxes.
Pick up the Starlet Motel Vicki card before the end of Chapter 2 if you are completing Delights Dancers; otherwise choose another set.
Sell duplicates at pawn shops freely — selling does not remove cards from the collection counter.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missable_note: Not missable. More than 100 scannable locations exist and any 100 count.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold D-Pad Up, then R1/RB, on foot — a popup warns you when a scannable spot is near). Any 100 count from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. The same 100 scans are also a 100% checklist line, so there is no extra work beyond the trophy.

trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Partner free-roam unlocks after Coffee Break (Chapter 2) and stays available.
trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Possible only after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle/Y), build up to four stars, then break out of the red heat zone — the trophy counts when you leave the heat radius, not the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cars and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give four stars, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal runs.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle/Y) so you are together, then cause enough carnage for a 4-star wanted level.
Escape on a fast motorcycle; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) breaks line of sight for police and helicopters.
Keep going until you are outside the red heat zone — leaving only the blue/red search area is not enough.

Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop for the delayed unlock; if nothing pops, rob a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.missable_note: Not missable. Repeatable in free-roam; gets easier as Focus levels up (max level 4).
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one Combat Focus activation (L3+R3 while aiming; time slows and weak points highlight, draining the purple Focus bar). It only lasts a few seconds, so prepare: fill Focus first (food, drink, or shower/wash at home), pop Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armour, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556 against gang-operation criminals. Soldiers, police and civilians reportedly do not count. Shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing all raise Focus toward level 4.

steps.text: Buff Focus before the fight: eat/drink or shower at home, then use Adrenaline (hold L1 > Triangle) to lengthen Combat Focus.
Line up five gang-operation enemies, activate Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) and drop all five without missing — an assault rifle is the reliable choice.
If it fails, level Focus via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, then retry; police/soldiers/civilians may not count.

Loot vault + cash drawer + safe, then escape the automatic 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go anonymous.
Repeat at five different vaults (Fleeca VCIA/Tequesta/Downtown/Ocean Beach, Lombank Downtown/Ocean Beach ×2, Shorefront Ocean Beach); do all eight for 100%.
